{{Documentation subpage}}
This template uses the following templates to automatically create a population table for the [[United Kingdom]] broken down by nation:
*<nowiki>{{UK subdivision area}}</nowiki>
*<nowiki>{{UK subdivision population}}</nowiki>
*<nowiki>{{UK subdivision density}}</nowiki>
*<nowiki>{{UK subdivision statistics year}}</nowiki>
*<nowiki>{{UK subdivision statistics citation}}</nowiki>

The table can be called by inserting <nowiki>{{UK population table}}</nowiki>
